title: The Symbolism of the Stupa
author_or_institution: Adrian Snodgrass; Cornell University Press / Southeast Asia Program Publications
author_institution: Cornell University Press / Southeast Asia Program Publications
scope: Comparative architectural and symbolic analysis of the stupa, including spatial form, axis, orientation and religious symbolism.
limitations: Comparative Buddhist architectural study, not a site-specific archaeological dating tool for an individual Sri Lankan stupa.

title: Elements of Buddhist Iconography
author_or_institution: Ananda K. Coomaraswamy; Harvard University Press / Harvard-Yenching Institute
scope: Textual and iconographic study of Buddhist symbols, including the earth-lotus, word-wheel and lotus-throne.
limitations: A broad South Asian iconographic interpretation; individual motifs still require local context, dating and provenance.

title: Mudra: A Study of Symbolic Gestures in Japanese Buddhist Sculpture
author_or_institution: E. Dale Saunders; Princeton University Press
scope: Systematic study of Buddhist mudra as ritual and iconographic signs, including principal and secondary hand gestures and their identifying functions.
limitations: The corpus is centered on Japanese Buddhist sculpture; use only for general mudra semantics and iconographic method, not to infer Sri Lankan date, school or provenance.
